name: 传承·张飞
title: 长坂怒将
body: human warrior in black iron and burnished bronze Han lamellar armor with white tiger shoulder plates and broad wine-red cape, gripping the long dark serpent-shaped spear, black topknot red cord and thick short beard
scene: alone on a broken Changban stone bridge, a single roaring white tiger apparition rising through blue storm mist behind him, defending the road toward distant refugees
story: 桥后的车辙里还有孩子的哭声，追兵的旗影却已漫过坡顶。张飞让最后一辆车先走，独自横矛桥头。众人只记得那一声怒喝，却很少有人看见他始终没有回头：他怕自己一回头，身后的人便以为他也在害怕。此篇为基于长坂传说的游戏化演绎。
move: 断桥惊雷：低身跨步，以蛇矛横扫前方；一条凝实虎形声浪沿地面推开敌阵。

name: 传承·张飞
title: 虎魄镇关
body: radically evolved tiger-soul incarnation: still unmistakable rugged Zhang Fei face and thick black beard, gigantic broad striped spectral tiger torso and forearms, digitigrade tiger legs and claws replacing human legs, white-blue thunder mane merging into red cape, ancient bronze plates floating along living tiger muscles, giant serpent spear
scene: his enormous evolved tiger body straddles a shattered mountain pass while clouds open overhead, ordinary people and carts tiny behind his protective stance
story: 人间的嗓音总会嘶哑，守关的誓言却未曾停息。山川记住长坂桥头的怒喝，将沉睡的虎魄交给张飞。他不再只是持矛的武将：筋骨化作雷霆，双足踏住险关，成为百姓退路上不会后退的山。此为幻想进阶故事。
move: 虎魄裂霆：虎爪蹬空，双臂逆拧蛇矛后向下贯击；成块的蓝白雷弧随虎形脊背掠出。

name: 神·张飞
title: 金阙镇岳
body: human divine guardian Zhang Fei with recognizable thick black beard and fierce broad face, dignified gold-white armor engraved with mountain ridges, dark red ceremonial ribbons, broad golden halo, jade-and-gold serpent spear, guardian tiger sculpted shoulder guards
scene: steps of a monumental mountain shrine above a river city, warm white sunlight, solid architectural clouds, solemn godlike head and crown
story: 山洪过后，百姓把无家可归的人迎进张飞祠。长明灯下，一尊怒目的神像忽然俯下身，将倒塌的门梁托起。供奉他的不是金玉，而是人们愿意为陌生人留出的一席安稳；于是守门的将军，成了护城的神。此为游戏原创神话。
move: 金阙镇岳：侧身踏空，双掌错开长矛，以环形金色山岳法印镇住前方。

name: 神·张飞
title: 四臂镇天尊
body: radically evolved four-armed mountain deity with Zhang Fei's broad fierce face and thick black beard, luminous ivory stone and gold body, four muscular arms clearly visible, two hold serpent spear, two raise vast jade ward discs, lower body becomes a hovering stone tiger and rolling white cloud pedestal rather than human legs, grand sun halo and architectural crown
scene: above a city of tiny roofs, four arms hold apart collapsing dark storm vault and open a dawn sky for ordinary people below
story: 雷云压低到城墙时，祭坛上的灯一盏盏灭去。张飞却听见黑暗里仍有人安慰孩子。他化出四臂，把倾覆的苍穹向两侧推开；一双手执矛拒灾，一双手托住人间。神威不是让人跪下，而是让他们能够重新站起。此为幻想进阶故事。
move: 四极擎天：四臂交错展开，双手横矛、双手压下完整巨型玉印光盘，形成清晰四向冲击。

name: 魔·张飞
title: 血誓不眠
body: human demonic Zhang Fei unmistakable rough broad face and short thick black beard, torn charcoal armor with obsidian tiger fangs and deep wine-red cloth, crimson eyes under a broken iron crown, huge jagged black serpent spear, bound broken chains around one forearm, smoke not gore
scene: a moonlit abandoned military camp, his dark shadow becomes an enormous crouching tiger behind him, restrained black-violet smoke and red pulse rings
story: 梦里没有庆功的酒，只有骤然熄灭的灯与未能说完的嘱托。张飞在黑暗里握紧蛇矛，把背叛留下的恐惧一寸寸折成锁链。他不肯让怒火吞掉自己的姓名，于是先锁住心中的猛虎，再向漫长的夜走去。此为虚构魔化支线，不作真实死因重演。
move: 断链噬夜：半空扭身反刺，左臂甩开断链，黑虎轮廓沿蛇矛突进，红色脉冲以宽环扩散。

name: 魔·张飞
title: 冥虎裂界
body: radically evolved shadow-tiger demon Zhang Fei: recognizable bearded broad human face fused into massive black tiger upper body, two huge obsidian claw arms, digitigrade tiger hind legs and sweeping smoky tiger tail, ridged hornlike crown, crimson fissures within muscular living obsidian body, no ordinary human silhouette, enormous black serpent spear with serrated crescentless point
scene: he steps across a shattered dream gate, violet-black mist forming large clear tiger shapes, crimson pulse rings, monumental scale
story: 那只猛虎终于挣断了梦中的锁链，却没有扑向无辜的人。张飞将自己的意识埋进它的脊骨，让每一寸利爪都记得该守住什么。冥夜因他裂开一道缝；从缝里走出的不再是旧日武将，却依然是那个肯为同伴挡在前面的人。此为幻想进阶故事。
move: 冥虎裂界：虎躯低伏后纵跃，双爪与蛇矛一同划出三道宽阔裂隙，拒绝细碎光点。

name: 机甲·张飞
title: 虎贲重装
body: human Zhang Fei piloting ancient Chinese heavy siege exoskeleton, recognizable exposed bearded face in open helmet, massive gunmetal and warm bronze mechanical tiger shoulders, red cloth sash and visible hydraulic-like bronze pistons, jade power core, a gigantic mechanical serpent spear with interlocking blade sections, broad boots
scene: ancient timber-and-bronze forge gate beside fortress, heavy mechanisms not modern factory, amber furnace light and cool jade core
story: 旧城门被撞裂的那一夜，工匠没有再赶造一扇更厚的门。他们把青铜虎首、承重机关与未冷却的甲片送到张飞面前。张飞站在吊架中央，让一副能替百姓挡住冲撞的钢铁骨架合拢。最后装上的不是铠甲，而是那柄仍由他亲手掌握的蛇矛。此为幻想机甲支线。
move: 虎贲崩山：屈膝跃进，整副重甲旋转，以机械蛇矛斜向下贯砸，推力结构清楚可见。

name: 机甲·张飞
title: 玄虎机神
body: radically evolved living mechanical tiger god, Zhang Fei bearded head at a colossal armored torso with four articulated bronze arms, lower body is a powerful quadruped mechanized tiger chassis rather than human legs, enormous striped gunmetal armor plates, jade furnace heart and broad bronze tiger jaw shoulders, serpent spear integrated with two forward hands, red banners streaming, lifeform changed not merely thicker human armor
scene: standing across a broken fortress gate protecting tiny townspeople, sky light awakened by a jade seal, monumental ancient mechanical deity
story: 机关甲本该在最后一次冲撞后停下，张飞却把蛇矛插进城基，让尚未熄灭的炉心与整座城的守备机关相连。四足支起新的门洞，四臂托住倾斜的城墙。撤离的人从他身下经过时，听见的不是齿轮，而是一句熟悉的吼声：往前走。此为幻想进阶故事。
move: 玄虎踏关：四足机躯腾跃，两臂以矛前刺，另外两臂展开完整大型护甲盾；不画敌方光束。
